members.title: I found solace from Silent Hill: Townfall's stealthy horror in the soothing Britishness of its abandoned homes
members.summary: I suppose, in a way, I asked for this. Crouched and cowering behind a garden fence, inches away from the thrashing, cleaver-faced miscreation who’d quite comfortably win in a fight against my splintering plank of rotten wood, I can almost hear Silent Hill: Townfall whisper mocking in my ear: not too much combat now, eh? aday.title: Talking Point: What Are You Playing This Weekend? (29th August)
aday.summary: Kept you waiting, huh? Well folks, the weekend is here, which means it's time to kick back, forget the stress of the working week, and play some games. It's been quite the week for Nintendo fans. Gamescom ONL revealed some pretty sweet treats for us, not least in the form of The Witcher III: Wild Hunt- Remastered for Switch 2, an improved version of Geralt's most recent adventure that's absolutely free for current owners of the Switch game.
